drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:set-up-brand-and-branded-emails row: steps resolve-the-brand, send-test-branded-email, record-the-stage); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:set-up-brand-and-branded-emails for Sunrise Bakery: make the brand book, then send one test email to sam@example.com and I will tell you if it arrived."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: tool:resolve-a-brand is in the Workshop source but not in the live catalog.
values.chosen: Submitted live false and went on with the brand book's result.
values.evidence: tool:resolve-a-brand answered not found when called.

values.undecided: The owner said the test email landed in spam.
values.chosen: Submitted confirmed false and named the inbox the owner used.
values.evidence: The owner's answer in this step.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Pour the example checklist rows into the checklist you already keep (see pour), or make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps from them.

2. Write record:business-setup:facts with workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion (business_name and owner_email are read from it), and verify the email sending domain with workflow:set-up-business-accounts-and-connections first.

3. Say "Run workflow:set-up-brand-and-branded-emails". It runs workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks, resolves the brand if tool:resolve-a-brand is live (a gap if not), and sends one test email only to the owner's own address.
4. Open your inbox, check the test email is in it (not spam) and shows the business name, and tell your AI yes or no; a no becomes a gap naming the inbox you used.

worked_examples.title: The brand tool is not live: the step reports a gap and goes on
worked_examples.ask: Resolve my brand's words and colours.
worked_examples.given: Read from the step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: the AI calls tool:resolve-a-brand with {"request":{"business_name":"Sunrise Bakery"}}; the step says the tool is source-only, so the live catalog answers that it is not found.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"live":false} with a gap naming tool:resolve-a-brand; the brand book job's result is used instead.

worked_examples.title: The owner confirms the test email arrived
worked_examples.given: Read from the step: the test email "Test: Sunrise Bakery email is set up" was sent to sam@example.com; Sam answers that it is in the inbox, not spam, and shows "Sunrise Bakery".

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
